completion_scope.component_status_tracks: Detailed upstream parity; in_progress does not imply prototype use is blocked.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.
deviations: Only independent item state; multiple/single policies, disabled and complete keyboard heading navigation pending.

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: Displays a callout for user attention.
deviations: Icon/action slots and exact new payment/feature demonstrations pending.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert Dialog
components.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
deviations: Explicit action layout, small size and media examples pending; shared modal backdrop and content animate.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.title: Aspect Ratio
components.description: Displays content within a desired ratio.
deviations: Native aspect layout works; upstream photo asset examples pending.

components.name: attachment
components.title: Attachment
components.description: Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions.
deviations: File states/actions exist; image/video media and full documented sizes/compositions pending.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.
deviations: Gallery uses matching pinned first-party portrait assets instead of mutable GitHub images; substitutions and hashes are recorded.
Native border blending, grayscale rasterization and circle edges differ from browser CSS.
English directional preview remains unported; translated text is outside the current scope.
Applications load/own textures and select image/fallback explicitly.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.
deviations: Default demo matches four semantic variants; clickable badges, icon slots and all documented previews pending.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.
deviations: Routing response exists; ellipsis/dropdown composition and collapsed examples pending.

components.name: bubble
components.title: Bubble
components.description: Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.
deviations: Seven fill variants exist; grouping, reactions, collapsible and markdown examples pending.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
deviations: Six variant/state pairs captured; exact icon/spinner compositions and remaining upstream previews pending.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button Group
components.description: A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.
deviations: Native controls join borders/corners as intended by upstream selectors; those selectors do not join all buttons in the current pinned browser harness.
Split uses the pinned Lucide Plus instead of Tabler Plus. Shadows and exact mixed-size focus stacking are deferred prototype polish.
Currency choice labels use one foreground rather than a separate muted trailing currency name.
Native voice-mode styling uses a scoped theme; source-specific wrapper radius/padding can differ slightly.

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.
deviations: Single/multiple/range and native date navigation exist; dropdown captions, presets, locale/week-number and complete range appearances pending.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.
deviations: Pinned login composition and grapheme-aware password control exist; exact header action/slot alignment, small/image variants and visual parity pending.

components.name: carousel
components.title: Carousel
components.description: A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.
deviations: Native retained slide motion and seamless periodic wrap preserve one widget tree per slide. Looping is disabled when all slides fit. Swipe/arrows/autoplay exist; inertial drag, plugins and full documented slide-size examples remain outside this prototype API.

components.name: chart
components.title: Chart
components.description: Beautiful charts. Built using Recharts. Copy and paste into your apps.
deviations: Native plotted data, inspection and activation exist; only basic chart kinds, no curved interpolation, Y labels or exact complete Recharts preview parity.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
deviations: The multilingual RTL preview has not yet been ported.
Native glyph rasterisation visibly differs despite matching Geist font files, selected faces and weights.
Yakui text layout rounds line metrics to physical pixels; card title leading differs by less than one logical pixel.
Native platform accessibility semantics and touch target expansion still require implementation and verification.

components.name: collapsible
components.title: Collapsible
components.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.
deviations: Click/keyboard activation and measured-height entry/exit work; upstream repository row composition remains pending.

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox
components.description: Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.
deviations: Single searchable popup exists; multiple/chip, autocomplete, empty/loading and full documented variants pending.

components.name: command
components.title: Command
components.description: Command menu for search and quick actions.
deviations: Native filtering and arrow/Enter work; grouped icons, command dialog and exact shortcut navigation pending.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context Menu
components.description: Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.
deviations: Right-click anchor and menu behaviours exist; full documented nesting/radio/layout previews pending.

components.name: data-table
components.title: Data Table
components.description: Powerful table and datagrids built using TanStack Table.
deviations: Filter/sort/visibility/selection/paging exist; row menus, custom cells, drag reordering and complete documented compositions pending.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
components.description: A date picker component with range and presets.
deviations: Popup selects dates; range/presets/locale and formatted/caption examples pending.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.
deviations: Autofocus, trap, Escape, backdrop and return focus tested; complete slots/sizes/scrolling, close icon pending. Entry/exit fade and zoom retain paint while closed content ignores input.

components.name: direction
components.title: Direction
components.description: A provider component that sets the text direction for your application.
deviations: Inline row mirroring exists; all component and text bidi/RTL preview parity not yet audited.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: A drawer component for React.
deviations: Bottom modal works; swipe/drag physics, handle, detents and exact Vaul layout pending.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.
deviations: English directional preview remains unported; translated text is outside current scope.
Popup uses opaque native surfaces; backdrop blur, saturation, soft shadow, hover delay/transit differ from upstream.
Typography and single-sample icon edges differ; targeted comparisons are retained without exhaustive parity certification.
Native keyboard scroll reveal and placement of large nested menus can differ from the source harness.

components.name: empty
components.title: Empty
components.description: Use the Empty component to display an empty state.
deviations: Basic slots/actions exist; media/icon/composition previews pending.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.
deviations: Label/control/error composition exists; label association, horizontal/legend/set/group APIs and complete variants pending.

components.name: form
components.title: Form
deviations: Listed in upstream navigation, but no Base UI documentation page at pinned revision. Native composition exists; form validation remains caller-owned.

components.name: hover-card
components.title: Hover Card
components.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.
deviations: Popup exists; delayed opening/closing and pointer transit contract pending.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.
deviations: Native Cosmic editing/selection/clipboard and disabled/read-only/invalid exist. Single-line passwords have masked grapheme/selection/paste editing. File controls, IME composition and exact full documented previews pending.

components.name: input-group
components.title: Input Group
components.description: Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.
deviations: Eight common English compositions are ported. Button/dropdown/custom textarea and remaining source examples are pending.
Source utility overrides for per-example font sizes, padding, monospace text and block-input heights are not all reproduced. Shared group focus and actual native editing/actions work.
Declare one editor and addon slots directly under the group. Multiple editors and automatic association with external labels are outside the current API.

components.name: input-otp
components.title: Input OTP
components.description: Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.
deviations: Digits/alphanumeric/filter/paste/edit work; complete selection, joined slots, blink and all invalid/disabled previews pending.

components.name: item
components.title: Item
components.description: A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions.
deviations: Basic variant composition exists; complete media/title/description/actions/group/link slots pending.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: Used to display textual user input from keyboard.
deviations: Basic shortcut hint exists; exact dimensions/group/icon previews pending.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.
deviations: Basic medium text exists; control association and complete leading/disabled behaviour pending.

components.name: marker
components.title: Marker
components.description: Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.
deviations: Default/separator/bordered visual parts exist; complete status variants and layouts pending.

components.name: menubar
components.title: Menubar
components.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.
deviations: Trigger menus exist; horizontal keyboard transfer and full documented groups pending.

components.name: message
components.title: Message
components.description: Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.
deviations: Avatar/header/body/end composition exists; grouping/actions/footer/media/RTL examples pending.

components.name: message-scroller
components.title: Message Scroller
components.description: A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.
documented_sections: What Makes a Great Streaming Chat Experience
deviations: Native follow, prepend anchor and jump exist; draggable scrollbar, saved-transcript/streaming examples pending.

components.name: native-select
components.title: Native Select
components.description: A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration.
deviations: Uses native Yakui select popup; OS-native HTML select is inapplicable. Sizes, groups, multiple and full composition parity pending.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.title: Navigation Menu
components.description: A collection of links for navigating websites.
deviations: The default English composition includes all three native flyouts and a direct route. App receives stable route/link IDs; the library does not own URLs.

Hover opens immediately and remains open until a trigger toggle, link activation, Escape or outside click. Browser hover delays/transit/automatic departure closing and shadows are deferred; flyouts and chevrons animate.
Long descriptions clip to two lines without CSS ellipsis. The Components layout targets the 1000px comparison viewport (two columns, 500px content).

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.
deviations: Page state works; ellipsis/icons and full documented responsive examples pending.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.
deviations: Anchor collision and dismissal exist; arrow offsets, full slots/shadows and documented variants pending.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.
deviations: Determinate track matches Nova height; label/value/indeterminate animation examples pending.

components.name: questionnaire
components.title: Questionnaire
components.description: A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.
deviations: Real required/optional/single/multiple/other navigation exists; shortcut labels, exact choice-card styling and all previews pending.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio Group
components.description: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.
deviations: One tab stop, arrow selection and separate-row layout tested; disabled/invalid/item APIs and remaining previews pending.

components.name: resizable
components.title: Resizable
components.description: Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.
deviations: Native drag and keyboard ratios work; configurable minima, collapse and all nested variants pending.

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll Area
components.description: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.
deviations: Uses Yakui bounded vertical scroll; horizontal/orientation/corner/styled draggable scrollbars pending.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.
deviations: English-only previews; the translated RTL composition is outside the current target.
Native scrolling and keyboard reveal replace the browser scroll-arrow affordance and dynamic popup growth. Selected-row alignment clamps near viewport edges.
Group/separator spacing, compact alignment, rounded item corners, shadows and source-specific field typography have minor differences; deferred prototype polish.

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: Visually or semantically separates content.
deviations: Horizontal native rule exists; vertical/decorative variants pending.

components.name: sheet
components.title: Sheet
components.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.
deviations: Four viewport edges slide with their actual layout and hit targets; close icon and exact slots/sizes remain pending.

components.name: sidebar
components.title: Sidebar
components.description: A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar component.
deviations: Collapse/navigation/theme basics exist; nested groups, provider shortcuts, tooltips, mobile mode and exact documented compositions pending.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.
deviations: Application-supplied pulse phase exists; reference shape captured; all documented compositions pending.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.
deviations: Thumbs share one retained widget with internal keyboard navigation; distinct platform accessibility nodes are not implemented.
Native keyboard focus deliberately keeps a visible thumb ring; the pinned browser example focuses its hidden input without styling the outer thumb.
The native input band is 20px across around the 4px visible track. Gallery vertical spacing compensates for this input padding.
Multiple/controlled values use the public range/value APIs; separate upstream multiple/controlled demos and RTL composition are not ported.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.
deviations: Shared-clock spinner_auto and application-supplied phase animate; exact documented Item/Button/size examples pending.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
deviations: The documented multilingual RTL preview is not yet ported; native scopes mirror track and label placement, with thumb direction mirrored.
Native glyph edge rendering differs from upstream; track/thumb dimensions and source field compositions are covered by paired screenshots.
Track/thumb transitions are interruptible; native platform accessibility semantics and touch target expansion remain outstanding.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: A responsive table component.
deviations: The documented multilingual RTL preview remains unported.
Columns use explicit logical widths instead of the HTML intrinsic table width algorithm.
Text rasterisation and collapsed half-pixel border sharing differ from browser output.
Horizontal scrolling supports wheel/trackpad and focused-control reveal; draggable scrollbar presentation and native platform accessibility remain outstanding.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.
deviations: Default and line styles support native roving arrow/Home/End selection. Vertical orientation, per-item disabled slots and additional source compositions are outside this prototype API.

Tab backgrounds/foregrounds and line-underline opacity animate. Native selection follows arrow focus; the pinned browser example requires activation. Soft shadows and exact border alpha differ from the source.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.
deviations: Native multiline editing and 64px minimum exist; full disabled/invalid/resize/field previews pending.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.
deviations: Manager expiry/actions and retained entry/exit/stack reflow work. Stable reusable row slots preserve button state through removal; layout, paint and keyboard order follow toast IDs. Pause-on-hover, collapsed hover stacks, drag physics and full Sonner examples remain outside this tween pass.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.
deviations: Click/keyboard pressed state exists; native icon, disabled, size and invalid previews pending.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle Group
components.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.
deviations: Single/multiple caller selections exist; roving focus, sizes, joined borders and documented examples pending.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.
deviations: Zero-delay hover/focus opening matches the site provider; composed and shorthand tooltips retain animated entry/exit. Soft shadows, rounded arrow rasterisation and pointer transit remain deferred polish.
Use tooltip_trigger with caller-owned TooltipState for Escape dismissal. The response-only tooltip shorthand has hover/focus display without trigger Escape interception.
English-only compositions; translated RTL demonstration is excluded from the agreed prototype target.

components.name: typography
components.title: Typography
components.description: Styles for headings, paragraphs, lists, etc.
deviations: Basic body/muted/headings exist; blockquote/list/table/inline-code/lead/small variants pending.

motion.scope: Continuous vsync game frames, native tweens, retained exits, periodic carousel wrap, toast reflow and Base-style tab underline fades. Idle hosts, non-vsync UIs, spring/drag physics and exhaustive browser parity excluded.
